data.exact_reserve_text: The release during 2015 on outstanding claims net of claims paid as at 31 December 2014 was GBP 14,497,316 with a further release of risk margin and unallocated loss adjustment expense provision ("ULAE") of GBP 11,655,032 due to claims being settled resulting in a total improvement of GBP 26,152,348. The release during 2014 on outstanding claims net of claims paid as at 31 December 2013 was GBP 6,808,120 with a further release of risk margin and ULAE of GBP 12,651,456 due to claims being settled resulting in a total improvement of GBP 19,459,576.
data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims development for prior years at 31 December 2015 was effectively flat based on the gross claims development table. The syndicate reports a material net release (after reinsurance) of GBP 26.15m in 2015 driven by claims settlements and releases of risk margin and ULAE. Key drivers cited include favourable claims development from settled cases, the impact of reinsurance recoveries, and ongoing uncertainty around PPO inflation and mortality assumptions. Operational and systems changes (and subsequent catch-up in claim settlements) are noted as having influenced the pattern of development.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development (PYD) could not be explicitly located in a single 'Movement in prior year's provision' gross column. The gross claims development triangle was used to compute PYD (result = 0.0). The report does explicitly state a net (after reinsurance) prior-year improvement of GBP 26.152m; no gross PYD figure is provided in the movement note, so the gross PYD is reported as flat (0.0) based on the triangle. If a gross movement note exists elsewhere, it was not found in the expected gross column.
